      Mail project 
      

        
Configure a Gmail or Outlook OAuth app once. Mailboxes of that provider reuse it. A mailbox that already has its own client keeps that client.

        
This switch applies to every mailbox while Kiki is open.

        

          
        

        

          
Gmail app

          
    
            
  1. In Google Cloud Console, create an OAuth client of type Desktop.
    2. 
            
  2. Paste its client ID and client secret here. Every Gmail mailbox reuses them.
    3. 
            
  3. If that client is still in Testing, add each mailbox address as a test user.
    4. 
          

          
          
          

            
            
            
            
            
          

        

        

          
Outlook app

          
    
            
  1. In Microsoft Entra, register an application and create a client secret.
    2. 
            
  2. Add delegated IMAP.AccessAsUser.All, SMTP.Send, and offline_access. The tenant may also need SMTP AUTH allowed.
    3. 
            
  3. Paste the application ID and secret here. If Entra asks for a redirect, use the loopback URI shown with a mailbox link.
    4.
